## Context

- Root cause (facilitator triage, to be confirmed by the red seat): GeneratedApi.FreeLoopbackPort (GeneratedApi.cs:230) binds TcpListener on port 0, reads the port, and stops the listener. The port is then free until the child dotnet process binds it via ASPNETCORE_URLS. In that window any socket on the runner can take it: another test class's API (xUnit runs classes in parallel; at least six classes call StartAsync), or an outgoing connection, since outgoing ports come from the same ephemeral range. The child then crashed with AddressInUseException.
- A second hazard of the same design: WaitUntilListeningAsync only checks that something accepts connections on the port, so if a foreign process held it the harness could report the API as up and talk to the wrong process.
- Failing run: https://github.com/Programming-Made-EZ/avowry/actions/runs/41020033271 (head fb13e3d, 2026-10-30 07:28 UTC). The facilitator missed this red at the time and did not stop the line; that miss is recorded with F-056.
